developer.title: Developer options
developer.clearExplanation: Removes everything this app stored on the device, including your sign-in. You will need to sign in again.

user.title: Profile
user.summaryPlaceholder: Share a bit about yourself – who you are, your hobbies, what you like to collect, or anything that shows your personality. Add a fun phrase, use emojis, decorate it as much as you want, and if you have collection-related social media accounts, feel free to include links

reports.title: Reports
reports.introMine: Reports are checked against the marketplace rules only. Coffer doesn't decide who was right in a deal.
reports.introAboutMe: When something you posted is removed for breaking a rule, you see here what and why. Who reported it is never shown.

index.reportsSubtitle: Your reports and moderation of your content
index.logoutText: You can sign in again any time with the same account.
index.pendingSubtitle: Items from your photos, by collection
index.activitySubtitle: What you did and when, sorted by kind

profile.noSummaryOwn: You don't have a summary on your profile yet — add a short introduction so others can get to know you better!
profile.noSummaryOther: This user has no summary yet.

language.title: Language
language.intro: Choose the language of the app. What collectors write themselves — names, descriptions, comments — stays as they wrote it.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.rowSubtitle: Permanently delete your account and your content
deleteAccount.goes: Your profile, collections, items, photos, listings, likes and follows. The text of your comments is removed.
deleteAccount.stays: Your comments stay in their threads as "Comment deleted". Your chat messages, trades and reviews stay in the other person's history, shown as "Deleted user".
deleteAccount.final: This can't be undone. You can sign up again later, but as a new user.
deleteAccount.tradesText: Finish or cancel these trades first. Shipped trades end when the buyer confirms receipt, or by themselves on the date shown.
deleteAccount.cancelText: The other person sees in the chat that you cancelled.
deleteAccount.cancelReason: Cancelled because I'm deleting my account.
deleteAccount.confirmText: Your account and your content are deleted now. This can't be undone.

pending.title: Waiting for review
pending.intro: Items found on your photos wait here for 30 days, until you add or delete them. Pick a collection to continue.
pending.emptyText: Items from new photos show up here.
